sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
React perf = **render less, render smaller, render later**.

- **`React.memo`** — skip re-render when props are referentially equal.
- **`useMemo` / `useCallback`** — stabilise references when downstream cares.
- **Virtualisation** — react-window / react-virtual for long lists.
- **Code splitting** — `React.lazy` + `Suspense`.
- **Concurrent features** — `useTransition` to mark non-urgent updates.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **Premature memoisation** is a common mistake — measure first.
- **Profiler** is built in — open the React DevTools, record, find the blame.
- **Long lists without virtualisation** — the most common perf bug.
- **Image optimisation** — `srcSet`, `loading="lazy"`, modern formats.
- **Bundle analysis** — `webpack-bundle-analyzer` / Vite plugins; trim before you split.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd profile with React DevTools, virtualise long lists, code-split routes via `React.lazy`, memoise only where the profiler shows wasted renders, and mark optional updates with `useTransition` so urgent input stays snappy."*
